root_proposition.text: Fictional Procedure Sable-17 revision 4 became effective on 3 March 2031.

sources.content:
# Fictional Sable document register

Training example only. All names, identifiers and dates in this record are invented.

Document: Procedure Sable-17
Revision: 4
Approval date: 1 March 2031
Effective date: 3 March 2031
Status: current in this fictional register.

The approval date records when the quality lead signed revision 4. The effective date records when that revision became the working procedure. Revision 3 ceased to be current when revision 4 became effective.
